title: Secure first adopter: confirm a downstream project integrating at least one scheme
context: Without a named adopter, open-transliteration cannot reach its Definition of Shipped. M0–M2 build adopter-independent foundations so the project is not blocked, but adoption is the true success event. A pause/decision point applies at the end of M2: if no adopter has been secured by then, the maintainer must make an explicit go/pivot/hold decision rather than continuing to build schemes no one is committed to use. verifiedNeed flips to true only when an adopter is confirmed.
objective: Conduct structured outreach to candidate adopter types (Wikimedia language tooling, library/GLAM cataloguing systems, Unicode CLDR, Translators without Borders/CLEAR Global, academic NLP groups, language-revitalization NGOs), confirm a named project or organization as the first adopter in writing, and record the agreed scheme(s) and integration needs. On completion, update related tasks with the adopter's name and set verifiedNeed: true.
acceptanceCriteria: Outreach conducted to candidate adopter types including: Wikimedia Foundation/language tooling, library/GLAM cataloguing systems and ALA/IFLA working groups, Unicode CLDR, Translators without Borders/CLEAR Global, academic NLP groups, language-revitalization NGOs
A named project or organization confirmed in writing as the first adopter; written confirmation recorded (email, GitHub issue, or equivalent)
Agreed scheme(s) and integration needs documented in docs/adopter/adopter-001.md or equivalent
The M2 pause/decision point is honored: if no adopter materialized by end of M2 foundations, the recorded go/pivot/hold decision governs whether this task proceeds
On adopter confirmed: related delivery tasks (integration-001 and others) updated with requestor name; verifiedNeed flagged for update to true in those tasks
Outreach approach, candidate list, and outcomes (including declined candidates) documented regardless of result
resources: PLAN.md — Open questions (adopter outreach plan); M3 definition; Problem & beneficiaries
COMPETITIVE-ANALYSIS.md — prior art and adopter landscape
output: docs/adopter/adopter-001.md (adopter confirmation, agreed schemes, integration needs, and outreach summary)
